ctx.x: Right, she sang and played violin with Irene's little quintet, and they made a lot of music. That's how -- I used to go over there and Irene would let me sit in her band, and when I wasn't working at the Gold Coast job, when it folded, and I could keep in practice, and that's how we got together and started going around together and finally got married.
